iso_retirement.comment:
Darkhat is in reality a dialect or regional accent variation of Mongolian Halh
(Darkhad or Darhad is often used for transcription of its standard form in Halh;
Darkhat is the preferred older, traditional orthography.) When Darkhad speakers
converse with Halh speakers from other regions they understand each other fully
without difficulty. They consider their language to be Halh.
iso_retirement.name: Darkhat
